createBody: Define inputs, production steps and the output. Save a private draft, then submit it for review before publishing.
loginBody: Sign in to create and save your own workflow.
sourceBody: Keep the public project's output goal and input notes, starting with an editable production plan. Configure the real steps and delivery method before publishing. This does not run the original project code or publish automatically.
sourceUnavailableBody: The public project directory is temporarily unavailable. Try again later. No project information was imported.
sourceMissingBody: The project may have been withdrawn or the link is outside the current public directory. Choose another project.
sourceSummary: A draft production plan based on the public project “{title}”. The author must configure execution steps and delivery.
